item.title: [IGNITE-7774] Missing Google Cloud libraries at binary release
item.description:
It looks like following libraries aren't included in the build:

  • google-http-client-1.22.0.jar
  • google-http-client-jackson2-1.22.0.jar
  • google-oauth-client-1.22.0.jar

Steps to reproduce:
1. Download apache-ignite-fabric-2.3.0-bin.zip (http://apache-mirror.rbc.ru/pub/apache//ignite/2.3.0/apache-ignite-fabric-2.3.0-bin.zip).
2. Unzip archive.
3. Move ignite-rest-http from /libs/optional to /libs
4. Move ignite-gce from /libs/optional to /libs
5. Update IgniteConfiguration in default-config.xml:

<property name="discoverySpi">
  <bean class="org.apache.ignite.spi.discovery.tcp.TcpDiscoverySpi">
    <property name="ipFinder">
      <bean class="org.apache.ignite.spi.discovery.tcp.ipfinder.gce.TcpDiscoveryGoogleStorageIpFinder">
        <property name="projectName" value="apache-ignite"/>
        <property name="bucketName" value="discovery-spi-bucket"/>
        <property name="serviceAccountP12FilePath" value="private key path"/>
        <property name="serviceAccountId" value="discovery-spi-3@apache-ignite.iam.gserviceaccount.com"/>
      </bean>
    </property>
  </bean>
</property>

6. Copy <private key path> into $IGNITE_HOME
7. Run bin/ignite.sh
8. Log:

vveider, thank you!

Sorry, not yet, but this task is next in my list.
Sounds good. Thanks

guseinov – can you conduct a test in branch IGNITE-7862? Possibly fix for flatten-maven-plugin will also helps with dependencies.
Also, please try adding the following snippet to modules/gce/pom.xml:

            <plugin>
                <artifactId>maven-dependency-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>copy-libs</id>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>copy-dependencies</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <outputDirectory>target/libs</outputDirectory>
                            <includeScope>runtime</includeScope>
                            <excludeTransitive>false</excludeTransitive>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>

dpavlov , sorry, I didn't. I am going to check it this weekend.
guseinov, sure.

vveider ,

1. Checked a build based on the master branch which includes IGNITE-7862. The issue is still reproducable there.

2. Added maven-dependency-plugin instead of manually added dependencies as you proposed before. It looks like a better way to solve the issue. I also specified the jackson-core version to avoid conflicts with apache-rest-http because ignite-gce doesn't include jackson-core 2.6.5 (it includes 2.1.3 by default).

I updated the PR please take a look.

TC results: https://ci.ignite.apache.org/viewLog.html?buildId=1158398&tab=buildResultsDiv&buildTypeId=IgniteTests24Java8_IgniteGce

Thanks.
guseinov, I guess this is the best solution for now. PR is good enough for me.
